# Tokyo Express: does a run deliver to this state? Japan itself or IJN (so the
# Marshalls/Carolines home-defense runs work - user ruling 2026-07-15). Deliberately
# NOT other subjects or allies: the faction-wide form was retired the same day
# because it buffed any coast-holding ally, e.g. a Japan-aligned Chinese Guangdong.
# Referenced by the auto-generated supply sweep (state scope).
JAP_te_state_supplied_trigger = {
	CONTROLLER = {
		OR = {
			tag = JAP
			tag = IJN
		}
	}
}

# Tokyo Express: is this state "held" for anchor election purposes? Same ruling as
# delivery (so icons only appear where a run would actually land), plus the debug
# override flag. Evaluated in STATE scope from JAP_te_refresh_anchors_effect.
JAP_te_state_held_trigger = {
	OR = {
		JAP = { has_country_flag = JAP_te_debug_anchors }
		JAP_te_state_supplied_trigger = yes
	}
}

# ── 派閥の存命判定 ──
# 粛清・失脚した派閥のディシジョンと国内勢力GUIの行を隠すための一元判定
# (JAP_factions.txt の visible と JAP_internal_factions_scripted_gui の triggers が参照)。
# 影響力変数は粛清後に0へセットされるだけで、存命でも0になり得るため判定に使わない。
JAP_kodoha_faction_alive_trigger = {
	# 死亡ルートは2本: 粛清NF、または「青年将校の蜂起」ミッションの期限切れ処理
	# (JAP_young_officers_coup の timeout_effect。NFを完了させずに影響力0化+このフラグを立てる)。
	NOT = { has_completed_focus = JAP_purge_the_kodoha_faction }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = young_officers_coup_fired }
}

# 統制派の失脚ルート(JAP_support_the_kodoha_faction)は本家9.6時点で効果未実装
# (focus_tree_coming_in_94)だが、実装されたとき自動で効くよう先回りで判定しておく。
JAP_toseiha_faction_alive_trigger = {
	NOT = { has_completed_focus = JAP_support_the_kodoha_faction }
}
